 Vertical Rotary Regenerative Air 
 Heater
 ليونجستروم
مسخن الهواء C-E الشركة الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية

This document lموجود
the minor maintenance procedure P1, which must performed on an annually 
bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The Ljungstrom 
air heater absorbs waste heat from flue gas, then transfers this heat to 
incoming cold air to increase the temperature of the incoming combustion or 
air process.

The first draft is initiated by 
eng. 
Emad El din Ali Elbana, reviewed by eng. Sadek Massoad, revised by 
EDEPC 
inspection & quality control 
at eng Samir Abd El- Gelil, Approved by eng. Mokhter Abd Ellatif; head 
Sector of Abu Soltan Power Station, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al 
Lethy EDEPC inspection & quality control head sector.

 regenerative air heater by coordination with the shift engineer.

 regenerative air heater is 
 OK and record the readings of clearance, temp., vibration, ... etc, and 
 compare with ref. values.
